title: Construction, structures, and interaction with DNA of two SmIII4 complexes

synthesis.procedure: Complexes 1 and 2 were prepared analogously by solvothermal synthesis; the procedure for 1 is given as representative. Sm(acac)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) was placed in a 20 mL glass vial, then CH3CN (8 mL) and CH2Cl2 (3 mL) were added, followed by Schiff-base ligand HL1 (0.025 mmol). The vial was sealed, the mixture was ultrasonicated for 30 min, and then heated in an oven. After cooling to room temperature, pale-yellow rod-like single crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained. Yield 56% based on Sm(acac)3·2H2O.
synthesis.time: ultrasonication 30 min; subsequent oven heating time not fully resolved in the converted text
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 20 mL glass vial; ultrasonic mixing then solvothermal heating in an oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature to afford pale-yellow rod-like crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction

properties.summary: Complex 1 shows ligand-centered UV-vis absorptions in methanol (bands near 205 and 250 nm assigned to intramolecular π→π* transitions of L1− and acac−, with an n→π* contribution from acac−). Versus free HL1, absorption in the relevant region is red-shifted; versus Sm(acac)3·2H2O, bands in the 200–250 nm region are blue-shifted, attributed to chelation. UV-vis, cyclic voltammetry, and GelRed–DNA fluorescence quenching indicate intercalative binding of 1 to CTDNA; Stern–Volmer Ksq = 0.41.

measurements.name: UV-vis absorption maxima (complex 1)
measurements.value: 205 and 250 nm (π→π*); additional n→π* band from acac−

measurements.name: DNA-binding Stern–Volmer quenching constant Ksq (GelRed–DNA)
measurements.conditions: fluorescence quenching of GelRed–DNA at 623 nm; r = c(compound)/c(DNA)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to complex 1, replacing HL1 with HL2. Sm(acac)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) in a 20 mL glass vial with CH3CN (8 mL) and CH2Cl2 (3 mL), addition of HL2, sealing, ultrasonication for 30 min, then oven heating and cooling to room temperature afforded crystals of 2. Yield 53% based on Sm(acac)3·2H2O.
synthesis.time: ultrasonication 30 min; subsequent oven heating time not fully resolved in the converted text
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 20 mL glass vial; ultrasonic mixing then solvothermal heating in an oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature to obtain crystals of 2

properties.summary: Complex 2 exhibits ligand-centered UV-vis absorptions in methanol similar to 1 (bands near 205 and 250 nm from intramolecular π→π* transitions of L2− and acac−, plus n→π* from acac−), with a blue shift versus Sm(acac)3·2H2O in the 200–250 nm region attributed to chelation. UV-vis, cyclic voltammetry, and GelRed–DNA fluorescence quenching indicate intercalative CTDNA binding; Stern–Volmer Ksq = 0.54, stronger than free HL2.

measurements.value: 205 and 250 nm (π→π*); additional n→π* band from acac−
